name: Bharti Airtel

snapshot.about: Bharti Airtel is a global telecommunications company offering mobile, home broadband, digital TV, B2B, and financial services.

narrative: Management delivered on top-line growth promises, with consolidated revenue reaching ₹58,500 crore in Q1 FY27 before advancing to ₹60,878 crore in Q2 FY27. EBITDA margin reached 57.0% in Q2 FY27, matching operational guidance and expanding from 51.0% in Q1 FY27.

promises.statement: Company plans to reach 1 gigawatt data center capacity in the next 3 to 4 years.

said.quote: Our plan is to reach 1 gigawatt capacity in the next three to four years and grow significantly ahead of the market

actual_source.quote: We are working towards our ambition to build one gigawatt in the next few years

promises.note: Target timeframe of 3 to 4 years is ongoing; management reiterated ambition in Q1 FY27 call.

promises.statement: Management expects FY2027 capex to be in the ballpark of FY2026 levels.

said.quote: So the net result of all of that, if you look at the capex, while we do not give guidance typically, our sense is that we will be in the ballpark of this year, give or take a little bit

actual_source.quote: Capex for the quarter was about Rs.13,390 Crores and the operational discipline continues to remain an enabler of our strong performance

promises.note: FY2027 is currently in progress; Q1 FY27 capex stood at ₹13,390 crore.

promises.metric: Broadband home passes per quarter run rate
promises.statement: Management has stepped up home pass run rate to reach 2.5 million homes per quarter.

said.quote: Here, we have stepped up our home pass, to reach 2.5 million homes per quarter run rate

promises.statement: Management plans to build 56 edge data centers over the next 18 to 24 months.

said.quote: There is a big project that is underway, which we spoke about last time on resilience, just a resilience of our edge data centers and we are focused right now on building in the next 18 to 24 months- 56 world class edge data centers

promises.statement: Airtel expects to allocate significantly less than Rs. 14,000 Crores over five years for financial services.

said.quote: the total amount that we are looking at allocating in the next five years, we have stated Rs. 20,000 Crores, of which Rs.14,000 Crores has to come from Airtel. It looks like it will be probably significantly less than that

promises.statement: Airtel Money is preparing for a London listing in H2 FY27.

said.quote: Given this growth trajectory and the large addressable opportunity, Airtel Money is now preparing for a London listing in the second half of 2026

signals.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹419,802 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹100,454 crore.

cash.read: Operating cash flow of ₹419,802 crore fully covered cumulative net profit of ₹100,454 crore over FY22–FY26, demonstrating excellent conversion of accounting profit into operating cash flow.

bull.point: Operating cash flow totaled ₹419,802 crore over FY22–FY26, fully covering reported net profit of ₹100,454 crore.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹419,802 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹100,454 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: Consolidated revenue reached ₹60,878 crore in Q2 FY27 with a 57.0% EBITDA margin, continuing growth from ₹58,500 crore in Q1 FY27.

evidence.quote: Our consolidated revenue was Rs.58,500 Crores, growing at about 5.7% sequentially
Our consolidated EBITDAaL was at Rs.29,800 Crores, this is a growth of 4.2% and the margin stood at 51%

bull.point: Operating free cash flow rose to over ₹16,450 crore in Q1 FY27, maintaining strong internal cash generation.

evidence.quote: Our operating free cash flow, which is EBITDAaL minus capex, was at over Rs.16,450 Crores

bear.point: Disputed tax and regulatory cases totaled ₹47,044 million across multiple legal bodies without formal classification of loss probabilities.

evidence.quote: The above-mentioned figures represent the total disputed cases without any assessment of Probable, Possible and Remote, as done in case of Contingent Liabilities

bear.point: Provisions and contingent liabilities for regulatory matters depend on significant management estimates and pending judicial decisions.

evidence.quote: The Company has recognised provisions for probable outflows relating to regulatory matters, as applicable and have disclosed contingencies for regulatory matters where the obligations are considered possible

bear.point: Consolidated capital expenditure reached ₹13,390 crore in Q1 FY27, reflecting ongoing heavy network infrastructure investment.

evidence.quote: Capex for the quarter was about Rs.13,390 Crores and the operational discipline continues to remain an enabler of our strong performance
